items.name: Garry Tan
items.bio: President & CEO @ycombinator —Founder @garryslist—Creator of GStack—designer/engineer who helps founders—SF Dem accelerating the boom loop—Loves using emdashes

topTweets.text:
Oh man Yahoo Tech... you got so close. You almost had it.

Better luck next time! https://t.co/yYmLHeQIOP
I like how Claude Code allows bash so the agent can’t use Write File tool outside its workspace but it can seemingly “cat >>” to any file in the file system https://t.co/DKrCZ8Kh1Z

We live in LISPy times for a specific reason: code is data and data is code again

But the weird thing? It’s Markdown.

items.name: Aditya Agarwal
items.bio: General Partner @SouthPkCommons, Co-Founder @Bevel_Health | Ex: Early Eng @facebook, CTO @Dropbox, Board @Flipkart | Optimist, Builder, Dad

topTweets.text:
A  lot of the conversation circa 2009 was about making the web 2.0 read/write and malleable.

We are living through that today but for all software. 

What if all software could be forked, changed, re-mixed and customized?

This new Mythos model is absurd.

What a time to be alive.

Whether you invest or you build -- please take a moment to appreciate what an incredible time we live in.

We will do this every million users up to 10 million.

Happy building!
